Name: Season Scan
Author: lilithds
Description:
[size=4][b]Season Scan[/b][/size]
See at a glance which seasons a seed, crop or forage item belongs to.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Adds a line at the bottom of the item tooltip, e.g. [i]Seasons: Spring, Summer (in season)[/i].[/*]
[*][b]Seeds & saplings:[/b] seasons the crop / fruit tree grows in.[/*]
[*][b]Crops & fruit:[/b] seasons the crop or tree produces it.[/*]
[*][b]Forage:[/b] seasons it spawns in any location (items with no season limit show [i]Seasons: All[/i]).[/*]
[*]Read from game data, so modded crops and forage work too.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/*]
[*]Run the game once to create [i]config.json[/i].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Config[/b] ([i]config.json[/i])
[list]
[*][b]ShowForSeeds[/b] (true): seasons on seeds and saplings[/*]
[*][b]ShowForCrops[/b] (true): seasons on crops and fruit[/*]
[*][b]ShowForForage[/b] (true): seasons on forage[/*]
[*][b]ShowCurrentSeasonHint[/b] (true): add (in season) / (out of season) for today[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
Works in single player and multiplayer. Safe to add or remove mid-save.
